description.narrative: This grant supports the Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition's 'Nourishing Food Pathways' programme (NFP) across all 11 countries of implementation. NFP works to accelerate food systems transformation to increase the consumption of safe nutritious and sustainable foods. THe programme is influencing to drive purposeful change to reshape the food system in support of societal goals related to health, nutrition, environmental sustainability, equity and resilence. The programme has six different work streams: Improving Policy Coherence and implementation in food systems to advance nutrition in eleven countries; inclusion of marginalised groups to improve decision making; Motivating and empowering consumers to shape food systems; Mobilising private sector finance for nutrition; Advancing policy coherence between nutrition and environment/climate action; Ultimately creating a new generation of evidence and data for stronger learning and accountability on food systems
